title: Structured Security Explanations for Learning-Based Vulnerability Detection
title_zh: 基于学习的漏洞检测的结构化安全解释

paragraphs.en: VulnLens用LLM生成七个视角的结构化安全解释并与监督检测器结合，显著提升二进制C/C++漏洞检测准确率与迁移能力。 Software vulnerability detection remains difficult because existing approaches rely on predefined analysis rules, learn vulnerability patterns implicitly from code and labels, or use large language models (LLMs) to make the final security judgment. It remains unclear whether structured descriptions of security-relevant program behavior can improve supervised detection. We present VulnLens, an explanation-augmented framework for binary C/C++ vulnerability detection that separates program-behavior analysis from the final decision. A label-blind LLM-based Explainer examines each function from seven fixed perspectives: data flow, memory access, object lifetime, arithmetic and type behavior, control flow, shared state, and external-resource access. Without receiving vulnerability labels or CWE information, it generates structured explanations. A supervised Detector combines source code and explanations through sequential cross-attention. We evaluate VulnLens on a PrimeVul-derived dataset covering ten CWE categories and test transfer to SecVulEval without retraining. On the 526-function PrimeVul test set, VulnLens achieves 75.5% accuracy and 77.2% F1, exceeding DeepSeek V4 Pro by 4.2 percentage points in accuracy and Gemini 2.5 Pro by 2.2 points in F1. Matched explanations improve F1 by 7.3 points over a separately trained code-only detector. On SecVulEval, VulnLens achieves 66.4% accuracy and 65.8% F1, outperforming DeepSeek V4 Pro by 7.6 points in accuracy and 20.0 points in F1, and Gemini 2.5 Pro by 16.6 points in accuracy and 7.8 points in F1.
paragraphs.zh: VulnLens用LLM生成七个视角的结构化安全解释并与监督检测器结合，显著提升二进制C/C++漏洞检测准确率与迁移能力。软件漏洞检测仍然困难，因为现有方法依赖预定义的分析规则、从代码和标签中隐式学习漏洞模式，或使用大语言模型（LLM）做出最终的安全判断。 结构化的安全相关程序行为描述能否改进监督式检测，目前仍不清楚。 我们提出VulnLens，一个面向二进制C/C++漏洞检测的解释增强框架，它将程序行为分析与最终决策分离。 一个不接触标签的基于LLM的解释器（Explainer）从七个固定视角检查每个函数：数据流、内存访问、对象生命周期、算术与类型行为、控制流、共享状态以及外部资源访问。 在不接收漏洞标签或CWE信息的情况下，它生成结构化解释。 一个监督式检测器（Detector）通过顺序交叉注意力将源代码与解释结合起来。 我们在一个源自PrimeVul、涵盖十个CWE类别的数据集上评估VulnLens，并测试其在无需重新训练的情况下向SecVulEval的迁移能力。 在包含526个函数的PrimeVul测试集上，VulnLens达到75.5%的准确率和77.2%的F1，准确率超出DeepSeek V4 Pro 4.2个百分点，F1超出Gemini 2.5 Pro 2.2个百分点。 匹配的解释使F1比单独训练的仅代码检测器提升7.3个百分点。 在SecVulEval上，VulnLens达到66.4%的准确率和65.8%的F1，准确率超出DeepSeek V4 Pro 7.6个百分点、F1超出20.0个百分点，准确率超出Gemini 2.5 Pro 16.6个百分点、F1超出7.8个百分点。
